title: System Design Fundamentals
intro: System design interview questions are the differentiator for senior and staff Java backend roles — capacity estimation, the building blocks (load balancers, caches, queues, databases, CDNs), data partitioning, replication and consistency, rate limiting, idempotency at scale, designing for high availability, and the trade-offs that show up in every system-design round (latency vs throughput, consistency vs availability). This page covers the fundamentals; for full case studies (URL shortener, Twitter feed, distributed cache) see the System Design Problems page.
